evidence.subquestion: Which sellers fall into the bottom quartile of customer ratings?
evidence.sql:
WITH seller_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM
        order_items oi
    JOIN
        order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY
        oi.seller_id
),
quartile_threshold AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(avg_review_score) AS bottom_quartile_score
    FROM
        seller_ratings
    WHERE
        avg_review_score <= (SELECT
            AVG(avg_review_score)
        FROM
            seller_ratings
        ORDER BY
            avg_review_score
        LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) / 4 FROM seller_ratings))
)
SELECT
    sr.seller_id
FROM
    seller_ratings sr
JOIN
    quartile_threshold qt ON sr.avg_review_score <= qt.bottom_quartile_score;

evidence.subquestion: What are the average review scores for all sellers?
evidence.sql:
SELECT oi.seller_id, AVG(review.review_score) AS average_review_score
FROM order_reviews AS review
JOIN order_items AS oi ON review.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY oi.seller_id;

evidence.subquestion: Which sellers fall into the bottom quartile of average review scores?
evidence.sql:
WITH seller_avg_scores AS (
    SELECT oi.seller_id, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM order_reviews r
    JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
quartile_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_review_score) AS bottom_quartile_score
    FROM (
        SELECT avg_review_score
        FROM seller_avg_scores
        ORDER BY avg_review_score
        LIMIT (SELECT COUNT(*) / 4 FROM seller_avg_scores)
    ) AS bottom_quartile
)
SELECT seller_id
FROM seller_avg_scores
WHERE avg_review_score <= (SELECT bottom_quartile_score FROM quartile_threshold);
